item.title: Mom’s statement in Buffalo Diocese bankruptcy alleges priest abused of her son
item.description: A mother delivered her impact statement in federal bankruptcy court in Buffalo last week, alleging that a well-known Diocese of Buffalo priest was connected to her 18-year-old son's death by suicide.

item.title: Foreclosure lawsuit adds new layer to long legal battle over former AM&A's building in Buffalo
item.description: The future of the former AM&A's building in downtown Buffalo is back in the spotlight after a foreclosure lawsuit was recently filed in Erie County Supreme Court.

item.title: Buffalo Parking Authority holds first meeting, appoints deputy mayor as CEO
item.description: The Buffalo Parking Authority met for the first time on Tuesday as the city looks to sell four parking ramps to help plug a projected $20 million budget deficit.

item.title: West Seneca police officers rescue 93-year-old man from burning home as fire spreads to his house
item.description: Body camera footage captured West Seneca officers rescuing a 93-year-old man with limited mobility after a fire spread from a neighboring home to his, on Osgood Avenue late Sunday night.
